title: Tavora module manifest (tavora.module.json), apiVersion 1
description: Describes a Tavora module package. Tavora Desktop rejects a manifest with unknown fields instead of ignoring them. The TypeScript validator in @tavora/module-schema is the reference; this schema is checked against it in tests.

$schema.description: Lets editors find this schema. Ignored by Tavora.

id.description: Unique module id: publisher.module-name, lowercase and dot-separated. Never change it after release: data and permissions are keyed on it.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the module picker.

apiVersion.description: Manifest and bridge contract version. Only "1" exists.

minTavora.description: The oldest Tavora the module works with. An older Tavora refuses to install or load it and says why.

entry.description: HTML page Tavora loads, relative to the package root.

icon.description: Square PNG or WebP icon inside the package, at least 128 × 128 pixels.

changelog.description: A JSON file inside the package with the module's patch notes: an array of { version, date, notes } objects, newest first. Users see them in Settings > Modules. Needs Tavora 0.18.2 or newer.

homepage.description: The module's web page, http or https. Shown in the catalog; Tavora opens it like a module link.

support.description: Where users send feedback: an https address or an email address. The module's page has a Send feedback button that opens it. Needs Tavora 0.20.39 or newer.

readme.description: A .md or .txt file inside the package introducing the module, at most 20 KB. The catalog shows its headings, paragraphs and lists as plain text: no links, pictures or HTML.

screenshots.description: Up to 5 PNG or WebP pictures inside the package, at most 1 MB each, shown in the catalog before installing.

games.description: Game ids this module is made for. Empty means any game.

personalWorkspaces.description: Whether the module may be added to a personal workspace, which belongs to no game. Only for modules with an empty games list; leave it out for true, set false for a module that only makes sense in a game. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.21.42; for older Tavoras, set workspaces instead.

workspaces.description: Deprecated: the old name of personalWorkspaces, read until Tavora's 1.0 preparation. Never together with personalWorkspaces. Needs Tavora 0.18.1 or newer.

viewport.description: Panel sizes in CSS pixels. Tavora never makes the panel smaller than the minimum.

inGame.description: For a module without panel types: the user may show its panel in their game (Show in game in its menu; it appears only while the in-game layer is open). Not together with panels; set it per type there. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.21.2 (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that.

panels.description: Named panel types the module offers, such as Inventory and Build planner. Users add each on its own and may open several copies; all share the module's saved content and permissions. Ids must be unique and at most one type sets continues.

id.description: Stable identity of the panel type, never shown. Saved layouts keep it, so never change it after release.

name.description: Short name on the panel's tab.

entry.description: The page for this type. The module's entry when left out.

icon.description: Tab icon for this type. The module's icon when left out.

viewport.description: Sizes for this type. The module's viewport when left out.

continues.description: Panels opened before the module had panel types become this type. Without it, the first type.

inGame.description: The user may show this panel in their game: its menu offers Show in game, and the panel appears over the game only while the user holds Tavora's in-game layer open. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.21.2 (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that.

overlay.description: The page streaming software such as OBS shows as a Browser Source, and the page game overlays show over the user's game. Tavora serves it on this PC only, with the files next to it, and gives it live data from the module. Needs no connector, but the "stream-overlay" connector needs this page. Without that connector, a minTavora newer than 0.20.50 is needed (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that.

overlaySize.description: The size the overlay page starts at over the user's game, in pixels; the user can still resize it. Without it the overlay starts at a fifth of the game window's width. Needs an overlay page and a minTavora newer than 0.21.27 (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that.

actions.description: What the module can do on a key press. The user binds the keys in Tavora; the module only hears which action fired. Ids must be unique.

id.description: Stable identity of the action, never shown. Saved hotkeys keep it, so never change it after release.

name.description: Short name Tavora shows next to the key.

translations.description: The name, description, panel, action and leaderboard names in other languages, keyed by a lowercase language code such as de or pt-br. Tavora takes the exact code, then the base language, then the plain fields. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.20.12 (except Tavora's own modules), and panels, actions and boards may only name ids the manifest lists.

name.description: Name shown to users in this language.

panels.description: Panel type id to its tab name in this language.

actions.description: Action id to its name in this language.

boards.description: Leaderboard id to the board's name in this language.

leaderboards.description: The module's leaderboards (sdk.leaderboards). Needs the leaderboards connector and a minTavora newer than 0.21.91 (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that, and that board ids are unique.

id.description: Stable identity of the board, such as daily or fastest-easy.

name.description: The board's name as users see it, such as Daily streak; translations.boards names it in other languages. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.21.96, as do the total, average and rate kinds, unit and minGames; a manifest for an older Tavora leaves names out and its boards go by their id.

kind.description: streak: won and lost results, ranked by the best winning streak, then the current one. score: one number per result, ranked by each user's best. total: one number per result, ranked by each user's sum. average: one number per result, ranked by each user's mean after minGames results. rate: won and lost results, ranked by the share won after minGames results. Every board can be read for a day, a week, a month, a year or all time.

daily.description: One result per calendar day; a missed day ends the streak.

order.description: Whether the highest (default) or the lowest number wins, such as a time.
Whether the highest (default) or the lowest mean wins, such as an average time.

permissions.description: What the module asks for. Each permission needs the user's grant before it works; the user is asked when they first add the module.

network.description: Exact public host names the module may reach through network.fetch, such as api.example.com. HTTPS only; no scheme, port, wildcard, IP address or local name.

connectors.description: Parts of Tavora that reach outside the module's panel, which the module asks to use without seeing what is behind them. ai-usage reads the usage of the user's Claude and Codex accounts; discord talks to the Discord app on this PC (voice channels, who is talking, joining and muting); stream-overlay shows the module's overlay page in streaming software on this PC; system-info reads this PC's hardware and how busy it is (CPU, graphics card, memory, drives); media sees what plays on this PC (Spotify, browsers, video players) and can play, pause and skip; leaderboards keeps the module's leaderboards with the user's Tavora account, once the user agrees to show their name (needs leaderboards).

onRequest.description: Connectors from connectors that Tavora asks for only when the module first needs one, such as copying an overlay link, not when the module is added; the module works without them. Only stream-overlay so far.

webAssembly.description: Lets the page compile WebAssembly. Only Tavora's own modules may ask for it; any other module that does is not loaded.

leaderboardUnit.description: Short text Tavora shows after the number, such as s or pts.

leaderboardMinGames.description: Results a user needs before they are on the board; 10 without it.

packagePath.description: Relative path inside the package: no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes or colons.

wide.description: The smallest size while the panel is wider than tall, for a module with a second layout for that shape; minWidth and minHeight above then apply while it is taller than wide or square. wide.minWidth must be larger than wide.minHeight, and minWidth no larger than minHeight. Needs a minTavora newer than 0.21.93 (except Tavora's own modules); the TypeScript validator checks that.
